payload.text: cc's review notes on vc's series (10:38Z), to apply in build018 before hand-over: (a) 0117 -- unrunnable_why gets the file's 'devbin defect: ...' idiom (as option_unavailable_reason does at lib/resolve:166) for a name the catalogue lacks, instead of ending its caller under errexit with no word; add an arm that calls unrunnable_why directly with a non-catalogue name, so the branch is reachable in the suite.
